generation_settings.grammar:
root ::= "{" space tool-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
tool ::= ("\"orders.lookup_order\"" | "\"orders.cancel_order\"" | "\"orders.get_refund_eligibility\"" | "\"refunds.submit\"" | "\"customers.get_profile\"" | "\"logistics.trace_shipment\"" | "\"inventory.check_stock\"" | "\"notify.send_update\"")
tool-kv ::= "\"tool\"" space ":" space tool

http.prompt:
已知 / known: order ORD-1042, customer C-9, sku SKU-1001, tracking TRK-88771.
Available tools:
- orders.lookup_order: 查询订单详情 / look up an order (params: order_id)
- orders.cancel_order: 取消订单 / cancel an order (params: order_id)
- orders.get_refund_eligibility: 查询退款资格 / check refund eligibility (params: order_id)
- refunds.submit: 提交退款 / submit a refund (params: order_id, amount, reason)
- customers.get_profile: 查询客户档案 / get customer profile (params: customer_id)
- logistics.trace_shipment: 追踪物流 / trace a shipment (params: tracking_no)
- inventory.check_stock: 查询库存 / check stock (params: sku)
- notify.send_update: 发送通知 / send a notification (params: customer_id)
客户询问订单 ORD-1042 能否退款。 只回答要调用的工具名。 / Answer with the tool name only.
Respond with the answer only, no explanation.
